info.title: Djinni API (Beta)
info.description:
## Djinni Applicant Tracking System API

This API allows you to manage job postings, view candidates, and track applications.

### Key Features

- **Job Management**: Create, update, and list job postings
- **Candidate Access**: View candidates who applied or were offered jobs
- **Application Tracking**: Track interactions between candidates and jobs
- **Skills**: Search and create skills, and attach required skills (with experience) to job postings
- **Webhooks**: Receive real-time notifications about application events

### Data Models

All data models are visible in endpoint responses. Click any endpoint to expand and view 
the complete schema structure. Key models:

#### Core Schemas
- **CandidateSchema** - Candidate profile, skills, experience, and application details
- **JobSchema** - Job posting with requirements, location, salary, and filters
- **SkillsSchema** - Skill from the catalog (name, status, timestamps)
- **Pagination** - Standard wrapper for paginated list responses (count, items, total)

#### Filter Schemas  
- **CandidateFilter** - Filter candidates by category, salary, dates, and interaction type
- **JobFilter** - Filter jobs by status, recruiter, and position

View complete field definitions by expanding any endpoint response in the sidebar.

### Authentication

All endpoints require API key authentication. Include your API key in the request header.

post.description:
Create a new job posting.

Creates a job posting for the specified recruiter. The job can be created as 'active'
(published immediately) or 'inactive' (draft mode).

Returns:
    201: Job created successfully with JobSchema details
    400: Invalid data or recruiter doesn't exist/doesn't belong to company

get.description:
List all job postings for the company.

Returns all job postings (active and inactive) created by recruiters
in the authenticated company. Results can be filtered and ordered.

Args:
    offset: Number of items to skip (for pagination)
    limit: Maximum number of items to return (max 100)
    filters: Filter criteria (is_online, recruiter, position)
    order_by: Field to order results by (default: 'id')

Returns:
    200: Paginated list of job postings

post.description:
Mark an application as viewed by recruiter.

Updates the last_seen_recruiter timestamp for the message thread between
the job and candidate, indicating that the recruiter has viewed the application.

Args:
    job_id: ID of the job posting
    candidate_id: ID of the candidate

Returns:
    200: Application marked as viewed
    404: Application not found

get.description:
Get candidate details for a specific application.

Returns detailed candidate information including profile data,
application details, and contact information (if shared).

Args:
    job_id: ID of the job posting
    application_id: ID of the application/message record

Returns:
    200: Candidate details with CandidateSchema

get.description:
List all candidates who have interacted with company jobs.

Returns candidates who have either applied to any job from the company
or received job offers from company recruiters. This provides a company-wide
view of all candidate interactions across all jobs.

Args:
    offset: Number of items to skip (for pagination)
    limit: Maximum number of items to return (max 100)
    filters: Filter criteria (category, salary, dates, action type, etc.)

Returns:
    200: Paginated list of candidates with their interaction details

Get candidate details for a specific application by application ID.

Retrieves candidate information for an application across any job in the company.

Args:
    application_id: ID of the application/message record

Returns:
    200: Candidate details with CandidateSchema

Get details of a specific job posting.

Args:
    job_id: ID of the job posting

Returns:
    200: Job details with JobSchema
    404: Job not found or doesn't belong to the company

put.description:
Update an existing job posting.

Updates job details and optionally changes its status between active and inactive.

Args:
    job_id: ID of the job posting to update
    payload: Updated job data
    status: New status ('active' to publish, 'inactive' to pause)

Returns:
    200: Job updated successfully with JobSchema
    400: Recruiter cannot publish jobs (e.g., invalid status)
    404: Job not found or doesn't belong to the company

delete.description:
Delete (archive) a job posting.

Marks the job as deleted and archived. This is a soft delete - the job
data is retained but becomes inactive and hidden from listings.

Args:
    job_id: ID of the job posting to delete

Returns:
    204: Job deleted successfully
    404: Job not found or doesn't belong to the company

get.description:
List skills in a listable status (`approved` or `review`), ordered by name.

Use the query parameters to filter and paginate the result.

post.description:
Create a skill in `review` status.

Returns the created skill (201). Skill names are unique case-insensitively:
if a skill with an equivalent name already exists (in any status), nothing
is created and the request conflicts (409). Look up existing skills via
`GET /jobs/skills/` before creating.

Create a new webhook. Multiple webhooks with the same action are allowed,
but each webhook must have a unique URL per app.
Status can be set to active or inactive (not failed).

put.description:
Update an existing webhook (full update).
Status can be set to active or inactive (not failed).
Changing status from failed will clear error_message.

patch.description:
Partially update an existing webhook.
Status can be set to active or inactive (not failed).
Changing status from failed will clear error_message.

status.description:
Current status of the job posting. Possible values:  
- 'draft' - Job is in draft state, not yet published  
- 'review' - Job is under review by administrators  
- 'published' - Job is active and visible to candidates  
- 'paused' - Job is temporarily paused/inactive  
- 'closed' - Job is closed by recruiter (position filled, no longer available)  
- 'archived' - Job is archived by system after a certain period
- 'failed' - Job failed to process properly
